unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Russian B1 has no current schema and runtime path for the reviewed full gender alternatives
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: The actual shared B1 schema only permits English/Spanish/French/Italian/Portuguese and strict lesson objects omit genderAlternatives. The current Russian runtime contains 100 A1 and 100 A2 lessons and zero B1 lessons. No genderAlternatives consumer is present in frontend/src or frontend/scripts. normalizeGuidedAnswer performs NFC, whitespace and case normalization, not ё→е folding. Thus the seven reviewed complete male alternatives and explicit е-spellings are not yet implemented acceptance evidence.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: Publishing through the current path would either reject the draft shape or omit the reviewed alternative input. A correct learner may be penalized for a male form or normal е spelling.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredAction: Implement and independently review a true Russian B1 extension with Russian/ru-RU identity and strict optional lesson.genderAlternatives keys '1'/'3' only. Map complete reviewed strings plus explicit е folds to the actual typed/spoken surfaces, preserving canonical target text; never generate suffix replacements or mutate frozen A1/A2. Confirm the B1 0.65/15-second scaffold and voice roster in the eventual integrated path.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Re-run the exact final Russian sources through the Russian gate and inspect real rendered Russian B1 fixtures and acceptance behavior. The later scratch gate under construction is outside this review.

reviewer.id: Fable 5.1 full twenty-lesson review and exact edit replay

readThrough.checks: All 10 lessons read field by field: dialogue (word counts 8-16/8-16/6-14/6-12 hold), chunk joins byte-exact, recall and cloze reconstructions exact, 2 blanks each with visible cues, speakRequired tokens present and off the denylist, trophies in d1 and example, captions quote d0 only, no d2 leakage, ё present (ещё, всё, пришёл, ведёт, жильё), no Latin/digits, staging (L1-3 imperfective мы, L4-6 perfective chains with genderAlternatives, L7-10 когда/пока/однажды, L10 licensed future) respected, 7 genderAlternatives complete and natural.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: Systemic coherence flaw found: in L4, L5, L8, L9 the learner narrates alone with я in dialogue[1] but closes with мы in dialogue[3]; edits below make those closings gender-free third-person narration. L2 d2 'вчера' tied to Sunday, fixed. L3 closing implied parcel still at the post office; fixed. Recall fallbacks that formed alternative valid sentences (L1 плыли, L2 пляж/вокзал) replaced with form distractors. Author batch report proposedAcceptanceOnly lists and word counts must be regenerated after edits.

readThrough.checks: All 10 lessons read: opinion frames L1-3 (мне кажется/мнение/есть смысл + потому что), concession L4-6 (хотя/зато/разница with real contrast), pivots L7-10 (однако/впрочем/пожалуй/наоборот + с одной стороны); all learner turns gender-free; impersonal-predicate cloze blanks with adjective-form distractors are uniquely valid; chunk joins, recall, cloze reconstructions exact; captions quote d0 only; ли only in interlocutor L3 opening; всё-таки recognition-only L6 d2; ё kept (Моё, Режиссёр, тёплого, вдвоём, её).
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L6 d3 'Мне приятно пить первый' flat as a preference answer → приятнее. L7 'повторять всё заново' is a semantic miss for re-entering text → писать. L8 d3 'вдвоём доедать её легко' unidiomatic and ignores the fish-menu cue → рыбный суп / съесть. L5 recall on a numeral had equally valid alternatives → blank центре (uniquely fixed by visible d0). L2 recall старый/новый were alternative valid readings → form distractors. L2 d0 'Какое у вас мнение после просмотра?' slightly stiff but acceptable.
